addPota: **Add your POTA activation too** — this event has no exchange of its own. It is scored from the Texas state park you activate and the parks you work, as POTA references.
scoring: **Score:** QSO points × (power + Texas parks worked + parks activated) + bonuses. CW is 2 points, everything else 1. A station counts once per band, mode and park; 60, 30, 17 and 12 m do not count. Outside a Texas state park, only contacts with one count.
bonuses: **Bonuses:** 5 for K5LRK, 50 for activating more than three parks, 50 for working one activator in three parks. The park-sign photo bonus is claimed when you upload.
submit: **Submit** at [tspota.org](https://www.tspota.org/) by the end of April.
